summary: An under-wing pylon of the H-6K: one cruise missile

stations.name: left outboard
stations.note: its place estimated on hangar's design of the H-6K: the six pylons 4.5, 7.0 and 9.5 m out (judged from the type's layout, not measured), a store's CG 40 % of the local chord aft of the leading edge and 0.65 m below the wing's under side. Its limit the heaviest of the missile family's launch weights with a margin: engineering assumptions
